item.title: An interactive explorer for Benford's Law across real datasets
item.description:
📝 What is the probability that a number, picked at random from the real world, begins with the digit 1. That this holds for a pure mathematical sequence — with no real-world data involved — is the first hint that something deeper than empirical coincidence is going on. People are looking up numbers starting with 1 far more often than numbers starting with 9.
🔗 Read more: https://vatsalbakshi.com/blog/benfords-law/
